result.reason: The revision improves the software warranty period and removes the fixed expiration date, but it does not reach the playbook position. It omits warranties that services will be performed professionally and workmanlike and that Commerce One will comply with applicable laws. The malicious-code warranty remains limited to code “willfully introduced,” rather than warranting the absence of malicious code generally. It also applies a single 12-month period triggered by delivery of the Software to both software and the hosted service, rather than using an appropriate service warranty period and trigger. The remedies are conditional and do not cleanly provide repair, replacement, or refund. Drafting defects also remain, including subject-verb disagreement, the ambiguous phrase “shall not apply only if,” and the incomplete trailing text.
